label: Up
definition: Increases net export to the system: more generation or less demand. In the Balancing Mechanism this is the direction of an offer.

label: Down
definition: Reduces net export to the system: less generation or more demand. In the Balancing Mechanism this is the direction of a bid.

label: Both
definition: The mechanism procures, or lets participants trade, in either direction; for example energy trading, where participants can buy or sell.

label: Not applicable
definition: The mechanism has no physical delivery direction, for example a cash-settled financial contract.
